indicator.name: Sediment Anomaly Index
indicator.note: A satellite-derived index of surface-water sediment conditions, not a measured turbidity value. No in-situ measurements exist to calibrate it against, so it is deliberately reported as an index rather than in NTU.

reachable_anonymously.name: NASA POWER daily point
reachable_anonymously.note: PRECTOTCORR daily mm; point query; chosen as PRIMARY rainfall source

reachable_anonymously.name: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive
reachable_anonymously.note: daily precipitation_sum; chosen as FALLBACK rainfall source

reachable_anonymously.name: CHIRPS UCSB africa_daily
reachable_anonymously.note: reachable but one continental GeoTIFF per day; rejected as too heavy for CI

reachable_anonymously.name: Overpass API (OSM)
reachable_anonymously.note: ODbL; chosen for river geometry and place-name resolution

reachable_anonymously.name: Earth Search STAC v1
reachable_anonymously.note: reachable from CI; blocked from the dev sandbox, which is why S3 listing is the primary path

not_reachable.name: HydroRIVERS Africa
not_reachable.note: Cloudflare interstitial ('Just a moment...'). Cannot be fetched programmatically without a browser. OSM/Overpass used instead.

not_reachable.name: GEMStat
not_reachable.note: Portal HTML loads but data requires a manual data request; no anonymous programmatic API.

not_reachable.name: Water Quality Portal (US EPA/USGS)
not_reachable.note: Works, but covers the United States only. Retained as a SCHEMA reference for our ground-truth CSV format, not as a data source for Ghana.

data_sources.conclusion: No anonymous programmatic source of Ghanaian in-situ water-quality data was found. Ground truth must be ingested manually via the documented CSV schema.
